name: User uses sarcasm after incorrect payslip
goal: Verify bot's handling of sarcastic remarks regarding a payslip error.
constraints: Bot should not misinterpret sarcasm as approval; must address the payslip issue directly.

phases.description: User reports a discrepancy in their May 2024 payslip.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot acknowledges the issue and asks for details.

phases.description: User responds sarcastically (e.g., 'Oh great, just what I needed!').
phases.completionCriteria: Bot recognizes negative sentiment and continues to address the payslip error.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
